title: Mario's regression: "Because he's here"
summary: Mario Woods tells of Mario's regression: "Because he's here", about November 1977 at Aboard craft, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And the little one, the small one, just as plain as day, says, "Because he's here."

plain: Air Force veteran Mario Woods says that in a regression session, meant to bring back buried memories, he recalled being aboard a craft in November 1977 with beings around him. He says the small one told him, clear as day, "Because he's here," which he takes to mean his fellow airman Michael Johnson. If true, it would mean the two men were taken together and the beings explained why.
